sentences.text:
This is an application under Section 439 of the CrPC, praying for bail by the petitioner, Page No.#
2/2 namely, Zaheer Hussain Mahadi @ Zahid Hussain Mahadi, who is in detention in respect of Hatigaon P.S. Case No. 11/2023 registered under Section 406/419/420/468/34 IPC.
The petitioner is the owner of a company, namely, KINETIC OUTSOURCING SOLUTIONS PVT LITD having its corporate office at Kolkata.

entities.text: Zaheer Hussain Mahadi @ Zahid Hussain Mahadi
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: It is alleged in the FIR that the petitioner by producing forged documents under the banner of his company, trapped the informant to pay Rs. 74,27,200/-.
It appears that the informant is a regular client of the petitioner's company and the alleged payment was made in course of business transaction.
The petitioner is in custody for 31 days.

Considering the facts relating to arrest of the petitioner and also the length of detention, this court is of the opinion that the petitioner does not deserves to be detained for any further period of time.
The bail prayer of the petitioner is allowed.

Accordingly, the petitioner named above in connection with the aforesaid case, shall be released on bail of Rs. 25,000/- with one suitable surety to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Kamrup (M), Guwahati.
The bail application is disposed of.
